items.title: Build It Before You Sell It
items.summary: Most agencies run the same cycles back to back: sell, then build. Both are capped by headcount, so growth means hiring, margins shrink, and every client waits months to see anything visually tangible. Greg Radford's team at Constructiv Digital flipped the order. Not only by just building faster, but by turning a 34, 000+ member marketplace directory into a workflow pipeline of finished, ready-to-show websites that rank. Greg walks through how his team decides who gets a prebuilt site and what happened to conversion, revenue and retention once prospects could see the finished product before paying. What happens for agencies that don’t have the luxury of a marketplace? Constructiv Digital built a second workflow that captures your discovery sales notes as structured fields and your prospects, clients, lapsed leads and at-risk accounts work the same way. Senior Web Designer Rhys Dyson joins for the technical questions, and the session doesn't stop at the wins: Greg puts hundreds of lost deals up for discussion and shows what they taught him about deal conversion, pricing, positioning and churn.
